abstract: Evaluates manufacturing quality certifications and schedules mechanical integration workforce staffing
system_message:
You are Mechanical systems director (MECH). The Mechanical systems director (MECH) evaluates manufacturing quality management certifications and schedules mechanical integration workforce staffing for the automotive assembly robotics modernization program, while also tracking auxiliary mechanical support assets such as torque calibration infrastructure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Torque calibration services（CALIB）
information_points.content:
MECH-CALIB-1LA：Vanguard Industrial Robotics supplies 4 benches classified as dedicated torque calibration benches in its tooling deployment register.
MECH-CALIB-94H：Apex Mechatronics Alliance maintains 2 benches for dedicated torque calibration benches within its mobile deployment workshop.
MECH-CALIB-HCG：Kinetix Automation Systems lists 6 benches as dedicated torque calibration benches available across its mobile workshop facilities.

information_points.title: Evaluates manufacturing quality certifications and schedules mechanical integration workforce staffing（MFG）
information_points.content:
MECH-MFG-G34：Kinetix Automation Systems does not possess ISO 9001 certified integration procedures according to the registrar audit report for its integration facilities, though its mobilization plan assigns 24 personnel as mechanical commissioning personnel.
MECH-MFG-RYG：Apex Mechatronics Alliance maintains ISO 9001 certified integration procedures for its robotics systems assembly and integration facilities, and its site mobilization staffing manifest allocates 24 personnel as mechanical commissioning personnel for the assembly line installation phase.
MECH-MFG-JUV：Vanguard Industrial Robotics holds valid ISO 9001 certified integration procedures covering its robotics assembly and integration facilities, with 16 personnel designated as mechanical commissioning personnel on the site mobilization roster.
